page.overview:
Who is Pruwet Richese?

Lord Pruwet Richese was the child of Ferdinand and Orla Richese. He was was betrothed to Ynez Corrino.

Pruwet was just nine years old when he was betrothed to Ynez Corrino in a deal their fathers arranged. Pruwet and his family traveled to the Corrinos for the ceremony. At the engagement ceremony, Ynez tried to get to know Pruwet, but he said they didn't need to talk as the ceremony was just a formality.

At the engagement party, Pruwet revealed to Ynez that he had a thinking machine toy in his pocket. When it got free, Natalya Arat Corrino screamed, as the technology was prohibited. After seeing Ynez defend Pruwet, Javicco decided they could overlook it, though Ynez told Pruwet she'd stab him if he pulled anything like that after they were married and demanded he get rid of the toy.

Despite this, Pruwet hid himself away and played with his toy. Desmond Hart found him and told him he had a great power, which he was using to win a war. That required sacrifice and he promised Pruwet's wouldn't be in vain. He then used his power to make Pruwet's skin burn, killing him.
